CompileError.doc: Compilation error. For this probe the only failure modes are (a) integer / real literal text that does not parse, (b) AST nodes outside the probe scope (Call, Col). Both produce a CompileError with an owned message.

CompileOk.doc: Successful compile: the emitted opcode list, the register holding the final result, and the next free register index (reg_base + count of registers used by this expression's sub-tree).

compile_expr.doc: Compile a parser expression AST node into a sequence of VDBE opcodes, writing the result into an allocated register and returning the opcode list + result register + next free register index. Pure function: no mutation of shared state, no side effects. The caller controls register allocation by passing `reg_base` — emitted opcodes write into reg_base, reg_base+1, ... up to CompileOk.next_reg - 1. See master.md §Algorithm for the pre-order walk.
